en.title: Archer Profile & Club Setup
en.excerpt: A complete beginner-friendly guide to setting up your athlete profile, profile picture, archery club, bow equipment, and highlight achievements.

toc.text: 5. Instant Autofill When Registering for Events

en.content:
1. Why Complete Your Profile First?

When you register for archery tournaments on Archeris, the system uses your birth date, gender, and bow discipline to automatically qualify you for eligible competition categories (such as U-12, U-15, U-18, Senior, or Masters), preventing accidental sign-ups in the wrong division.

2. Step-by-Step Profile Setup

To configure your athlete profile:

  1. Log in to your Archeris account and go to Archer Dashboard > Profile (/dashboard/archer/profile).
  2. On the Personal Info & Contact tab, fill in the following fields:
    • Avatar & Header Banner: Upload a clear photo of yourself so organizers and lane marshals can recognize you on the shooting line.
    • Full Legal Name: Enter your real name as shown on official ID/Passport (this name will be printed on official competition certificates).
    • Username: Choose a unique handle for your public athlete portfolio page (e.g., archeris.net/archers/yourname).
    • Date of Birth & Gender: Required for automatic tournament age division calculation.
    • Height & Weight: (Optional) Personal biometric references.

3. Selecting Your Club & Bow Discipline

Scroll down to the Athlete Specs & Club section on the same page:

  • Primary Bow Type: Select the bow you shoot (Recurve, Compound, Barebow, or Traditional).
  • Hand Dominance: Choose Right-Handed or Left-Handed to help lane marshals arrange shooting line space comfortably.
  • Archery Club / Contingent: Search for your registered club name. If your club is not yet on Archeris, choose the option to enter a new club name and acronym.

4. Adding Bio & Star Achievements

Click on the second tab, Biography & Achievements:

  • About Me (Bio): Write a short intro about your archery journey, current goals, or club background.
  • Career Achievements: List your tournament milestones and medals. Click the Star icon on your top 3 achievements to highlight them prominently on your public athlete profile.
  • Event Certificates: Access and download all your verified digital competition certificates from past events.

5. Instant Autofill When Registering for Events

Once your profile is saved, signing up for any tournament on Archeris takes less than 30 seconds. The registration checkout automatically pulls your verified name, club, age bracket, and contact details so you never have to re-type them for every new championship!
